name: Gakumagawa Senri
source:
Works at a bathhouse (brothel). Whether it is her personalty or experience, she the ideal woman that is both friendly and beautiful, and seemingly understanding of her customers' needs. 

She is in love with one of her customers and wants to get married to them. Her boyfriend said if she got pregnant he would marry her and she would be able to leave the prostitution business. Promising him she wouldn't let anyone come inside her, she would claim the kid as his.
